capabilities.label: NL-query + agentic AI now table stakes
capabilities.detail: — everyone ships "chat with your data" grounded in a semantic model (Power BI Copilot, Tableau Agent/Pulse, Looker Conversational Analytics, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, Databricks Genie, Amplitude Ask). Frontier moved from NLQ to autonomous **AI agents** (Amplitude AI Agents, Databricks Agent Bricks, Snowflake Cortex Agents, Tableau Agentforce).
features: — everyone ships "chat with your data" grounded in a semantic model (Power BI Copilot, Tableau Agent/Pulse, Looker Conversational Analytics, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, Databricks Genie, Amplitude Ask). Frontier moved from NLQ to autonomous **AI agents** (Amplitude AI Agents, Databricks Agent Bricks, Snowflake Cortex Agents, Tableau Agentforce).

capabilities.label: Semantic/metrics layer is the strategic battleground
capabilities.detail: — define-metrics-once governed models (LookML the pioneer, now openable to rival BI via Open SQL Interface; Power BI semantic models; Snowflake semantic models for Cortex; Databricks Unity Catalog Business Semantics; Tableau Semantics).
features: — define-metrics-once governed models (LookML the pioneer, now openable to rival BI via Open SQL Interface; Power BI semantic models; Snowflake semantic models for Cortex; Databricks Unity Catalog Business Semantics; Tableau Semantics).

capabilities.label: Governed catalog + column-level lineage
capabilities.detail: — Tableau Catalog, Purview, Snowflake Horizon, Databricks Unity Catalog: discovery, sensitive-data classification, tagging, RBAC + row/column-level security, dynamic masking, lineage/impact.

capabilities.label: Consumption pricing at platform tier vs per-user at BI tier
capabilities.detail: — Snowflake (credits) + Databricks (DBUs) bill per-second compute with storage/compute separation; BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) bill per-user/role (Databricks markets "no per-seat limits" for BI).
features: — Snowflake (credits) + Databricks (DBUs) bill per-second compute with storage/compute separation; BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) bill per-user/role (Databricks markets "no per-seat limits" for BI).

capabilities.label: Embedded analytics + developer APIs everywhere
capabilities.detail: — Tableau Embedding API v3, Power BI Embedded, Looker Embed SDK / Extension Framework, REST APIs + multi-language SDKs; white-labeling, SSO, row-level scoping universal.

capabilities.label: Open lakehouse + Apache Iceberg convergence
capabilities.detail: — Snowflake + Databricks both support managed Iceberg + REST catalogs, open no-copy data sharing (Secure Data Sharing / Delta Sharing), Marketplaces, and Clean Rooms.
features: — Snowflake + Databricks both support managed Iceberg + REST catalogs
open no-copy data sharing (Secure Data Sharing / Delta Sharing)

capabilities.label: Streaming/real-time as first-class
capabilities.detail: — Snowpipe Streaming + Dynamic Tables, Databricks Structured Streaming + Streaming Tables, Power BI Fabric Real-Time Intelligence, Segment 400K events/sec; CDC a common primitive.
features: Segment 400K events/sec; CDC a common primitive.

capabilities.label: CDP triad — identity, audiences, activation, reverse ETL
capabilities.detail: — Segment + Amplitude share identity resolution/golden profiles, behavioral audiences, activation to 300–750+ destinations. Warehouse-native patterns converge the categories (Segment Linked Audiences/Reverse ETL query the warehouse; the warehouses themselves push into CDP territory — Databricks CustomersLake).
features: — Segment + Amplitude share identity resolution/golden profiles

activation to 300–750+ destinations. Warehouse-native patterns converge the categories (Segment Linked Audiences/Reverse ETL query the warehouse; the warehouses themselves push into CDP territory — Databricks CustomersLake).

capabilities.label: Predictive/AI on customer data
capabilities.detail: — Segment CustomerAI + Amplitude ship packaged predictions (LTV/churn/purchase propensity) + generative audience creation from NL.
features: — Segment CustomerAI + Amplitude ship packaged predictions (LTV/churn/purchase propensity) + generative audience creation from NL.

capabilities.label: Product-analytics primitives (Amplitude's niche)
capabilities.detail: — funnels/retention/cohorts/user paths/lifecycle + session replay + in-product guides/surveys + A/B experimentation as an integrated suite the general BI tools don't natively cover.
features: — funnels/retention/cohorts/user paths/lifecycle + session replay + in-product guides/surveys + A/B experimentation as an integrated suite the general BI tools don't natively cover.

capabilities.label: Governance of AI itself is the newest layer
capabilities.detail: — Databricks Mosaic AI Gateway + Snowflake Cortex AI Guardrails govern LLM/MCP usage (rate limiting, PII/PHI redaction, lineage); Amplitude AI Governance / Agent Analytics observe agent behavior.
features: — Databricks Mosaic AI Gateway + Snowflake Cortex AI Guardrails govern LLM/MCP usage (rate limiting, PII/PHI redaction, lineage); Amplitude AI Governance / Agent Analytics observe agent behavior.

capabilities.label: Collaboration/scheduled delivery/threshold alerting
capabilities.detail: baseline (email/Slack subscriptions, data-driven alerts, commenting, mobile); differentiator shifted to AI-generated proactive alerts + anomaly detection (Tableau Pulse, Power BI Data Activator, Amplitude monitors).
